newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel to detail results on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel to detail results on Tuesday.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom is set to publish its 1996 results on Tuesday morning, with analysts waiting to see the details of how the group clawed back to the black.
The industrial engineering and telecoms equipment group said on January 30 that its net profit for 1996 would be some 2.5 billion francs, against a loss of 25.6 billion francs for 1995.
Chairman Serge Tchuruk is expected to outline how the recovery is working through at the company's divisions and how he aims to push the group to a "satisfactory level of profitability" in 1998.
The Tuesday news conference is also the first public appearance of Tchuruk after the relaunch of the privatisation process for the state's 58 percent stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.
Alcatel has teamed up with private Dassault Industries to bid for the company, in competition with Lagardere Groupe.
Tchuruk had earlier this year also drafted state-owned Aerospatiale for a joint offer but the government last week said Aerospatiale could not join the bidding process.
